title: Payment tolerance and senior-review branches
summary: A real switch graph routes reconciled, officer-review, senior-review and invalid-data outcomes. The OMR 100 threshold is fictional.
learning: Change branches in the visual switch grid
Use source-bound baisa amounts
Test equality boundaries, shortfalls, invalid types and outages

statements.condition: proposedBaisa < 0 or approvedBaisa < 0 or toleranceBaisa < 0 or floor(proposedBaisa) != proposedBaisa or floor(approvedBaisa) != approvedBaisa or floor(adjustmentBaisa) != adjustmentBaisa or floor(toleranceBaisa) != toleranceBaisa

expressions.value: "Amounts must be whole baisa; proposed, approved and tolerance amounts cannot be negative"
"Difference of at least OMR 100 requires senior review in this fictional exercise"
"Difference exceeds tolerance and needs evidence review"

scenarios.name: Proposed below approved
scenarios.explanation: Absolute difference routes a shortfall too.

scenarios.name: Invalid negative tolerance
scenarios.explanation: Bad financial input cannot be treated as a confirmed discrepancy.

scenarios.name: Nonnumeric proposed amount
scenarios.explanation: Invalid source type must not become zero.

title: Readiness data contracts and birthday boundaries
summary: Checks evidence readiness plus required fields, real dates, boolean types and age transformation. Readiness never means pension entitlement.
learning: Read age from mapped DOB at the assessment date
Inspect actual mapping issues
Separate data validity from business readiness

config.name: Readiness data contracts and birthday boundaries

rules.reason: "Missing-document count must be a nonnegative whole number"

scenarios.name: Complete on 60th birthday
scenarios.explanation: DOB maps to age 60; readiness uses evidence checks.

scenarios.name: Joining dates disagree
scenarios.explanation: Keep both source dates and request evidence.

scenarios.name: One mandatory document missing
scenarios.explanation: Do not proceed with incomplete evidence.

scenarios.name: Service unverified
scenarios.explanation: Do not treat unverified months as verified.

scenarios.name: DOB missing
scenarios.explanation: Required source data must be present.

scenarios.name: Negative missing count
scenarios.explanation: A negative evidence count is invalid.

scenarios.name: Day before 60th birthday
scenarios.explanation: DOB maps to age 59. No statutory age rule is implied.

scenarios.name: String instead of boolean
scenarios.explanation: Literal true text cannot silently become boolean true.

title: Contribution receipt boundaries
summary: Whole-baisa reconciliation catches underpayments, excess receipts and invalid source amounts.
learning: Compare the sign as well as status
Keep exact integer money units
Handle missing facts and unavailable sources

expressions.value: not (expectedBaisa >= 0 and receivedBaisa >= 0 and floor(expectedBaisa) == expectedBaisa and floor(receivedBaisa) == receivedBaisa) ? "UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE" : (expectedBaisa == receivedBaisa ? "CLEAR" : "FINDING")

not (expectedBaisa >= 0 and receivedBaisa >= 0 and floor(expectedBaisa) == expectedBaisa and floor(receivedBaisa) == receivedBaisa) ? "Source amounts must be nonnegative whole baisa" : (expectedBaisa == receivedBaisa ? "Contributions reconcile" : "Contribution difference requires reconciliation")

scenarios.name: Both supplied amounts zero
scenarios.explanation: Compares supplied amounts; this is not proof a period was due.

scenarios.name: Negative receipt
scenarios.explanation: Reject invalid input before a business finding.

scenarios.name: Source unavailable
scenarios.explanation: No fabricated amount after HTTP failure.

title: Service evidence boundaries
summary: Investigate supplied overlap/unverified months, including both together. Invalid counts remain a source correction.
learning: Explain two concurrent exception reasons
Reject negative/missing counts
Keep assessment and case approvals separate

expressions.value: not (overlapMonths >= 0 and unverifiedMonths >= 0 and floor(overlapMonths) == overlapMonths and floor(unverifiedMonths) == unverifiedMonths) ? "UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE" : (overlapMonths > 0 or unverifiedMonths > 0 ? "FINDING" : "CLEAR")

not (overlapMonths >= 0 and unverifiedMonths >= 0 and floor(overlapMonths) == overlapMonths and floor(unverifiedMonths) == unverifiedMonths) ? "Source month counts must be nonnegative whole numbers" : (overlapMonths > 0 and unverifiedMonths > 0 ? "Overlap and unverified months both require investigation" : (overlapMonths > 0 ? "Overlapping service periods require investigation" : (unverifiedMonths > 0 ? "Service months await verification" : "Configured service checks passed")))

scenarios.name: No supplied exception
scenarios.explanation: Zero overlap and unverified months; not statutory certification.

scenarios.name: Overlap and unverified months
scenarios.explanation: Both investigation reasons should be visible.

expectedOutput.reason: Overlap and unverified months both require investigation

scenarios.name: Negative overlap count
scenarios.explanation: Bad data must not appear clear.

scenarios.name: Verification count missing
scenarios.explanation: An empty service source is not a clean record.

scenarios.name: Fractional month count
scenarios.explanation: This particular configured contract requires whole months.

scenarios.name: Source unavailable
scenarios.explanation: Retrieve fresh facts after source recovery.
